scoring_note: Most comparison groups are lower-is-better. Synthetic-gap holdout methods are diagnostic refits trained after contiguous raw windows were deleted; they are excluded from the normal overall leaderboard and ranked separately by deleted-point interpolation error. Use group metrics, aviation_detail_metrics.csv, trajectory_model_metrics.csv, and synthetic_gap_holdout_metrics.csv to interpret why a method wins.
